name: autocomplete-virtual
title: Autocomplete Virtualised
description: Virtualised autocomplete wrapper using @tanstack/react-virtual — renders large flat lists efficiently without grouping.

files.content:
type allowedPrimitiveT = string | number | boolean

type optionT = {
  label: React.ReactNode
  value: allowedPrimitiveT
  className?: string
  disabled?: boolean
}

type groupT = {
  group: string
  options: (allowedPrimitiveT | optionT)[]
  className?: string
}

type optionsT = (allowedPrimitiveT | optionT | groupT)[]

type indicatorAtT = 'right' | 'left'
